availability.covote: CN10/11 character and music complete four-cell matrices; JP11-22 character and music official published leading lists; all other round/category sources are unavailable and omitted rather than filled with zero

covote_metrics.raw_count: published m00/intersection; JP directional raw counts retained separately
covote_metrics.conditional_rate: direction-specific P(B|A) or P(A|B) from the published conditional row
covote_metrics.lift: CN complete 2x2 independence lift; JP published conditional_rate/overall_rate only
covote_metrics.complete_matrix_sources: CN10/11 same-department character and music matrices
covote_metrics.jp_policy: JP leading association lists never receive fabricated missing-pair zeros or complete 2x2 metrics

availability.questionnaire: CN1-11 static/modern aggregate tables plus JP17-22 (question availability varies by round)
availability.entity_questionnaire_links: CN2-4 official detail-page vote-group marginals, CN5-11 questionnaire-conditioned character/music/CP rows, plus JP17-22 character/music/work
availability.cn_advanced_search: CN5-11 normalized atomic questionnaire/entity conditions; CN5-9 include the official questionnaire pair matrix; CN10-11 expose Boolean AND/OR queries on demand but no legacy all-answer pair endpoint
availability.work_catalog: CN legacy translated catalogue plus maintained JP modern additions; release_order is independent of vote rank
availability.character_factions: THBWiki-backed conservative original-setting groups plus separate first-appearance work cohorts; unverified characters remain unclassified
availability.character_music_links: CN1-11, JP3-22 direct character_theme relations from music_associations.csv; scene and derivative relations excluded
availability.music_associations: CN1-11, JP3-22 typed character_theme, scene_context, and derivative_source relations
availability.character_pair_structure_features: Observed character co-vote pairs joined to character_structure_metadata.csv; each attribute comparison is true/false only when both endpoints are confirmed, otherwise unknown
availability.character_music_covote: CN10-11 official advanced-condition checkpoints plus JP17-22 official character detail pages; count=P(character and music), rate=P(music|character voters participating in music)
availability.music_arrangement_counts: JP4-22 and CN2-11 THBWiki original-song inter-vote increments, cumulative dated counts through each vote end, and crawl-time all-history totals; CN1 is baseline-only and same-numbered JP/CN rounds use independent calendars
availability.music_arrangement_cross: JP4-22 and CN2-11 song-vote and character-vote scatter analysis with three selectable x-axis scopes: inter-vote increment, cumulative dated count through vote end, or crawl-time cumulative total; CN1 has no inter-vote increment; character totals deduplicate mapped canonical original songs

music_catalog_standardization.note: Unmatched titles are retained with source names; no ambiguous fuzzy merge is forced.

availability.character_comments: CN1-11, JP3-22 comment aggregates; ambiguous/unmatched/error rows remain blank

character_pair_structure.unknown_feature_policy: A same_* or shared_* value is unknown when either endpoint attribute is blank, unknown, or unresolved; missing is never false.

cn_advanced_contract.scope: CN5–11 official bounded advanced-search extracts; CN10–11 rebuild the legacy pair-cell surface with explicit Boolean intersection queries

10.pair_reason: modern GraphQL has no legacy all-answer questionnaire cross-tab endpoint; the crawler enumerates every explicit Boolean answer cell

character_comments.join_policy: 先按地区/届次/非空源实体 ID，再按唯一中日名称别名；同名歧义、多个别名冲突或同一来源重复挂接标记 ambiguous 并留空。
character_comments.interpretation: 公开投票评论/理由是文本参与度与表达形状旁证，不是票数、支持度、情绪或因果变量。
